ents.n: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

notes: North-east New Guinea was German; Papua was Australian.
Finland, Georgia, Armenia and Azerbaijan were part of the Russian Empire in 1914.
Corrected (AP review): Morocco was a French protectorate from 1912; Malaya was under British control; Xinjiang was a province of the Republic of China.
Names are the ones in use on this map’s date.
The Panama Canal Zone (1903-1979) is drawn as United States territory (line approximate).
Eastern Thrace, with Edirne and Istanbul, is Ottoman again, as the Treaty of Constantinople (1913) left it; Bulgaria keeps Western Thrace.

Aegean islands that were in no realm are given to the state that held them: Crete and the islands taken in 1912 to Greece, Rhodes and the Dodecanese to Italy, the rest to the Ottoman Empire before 1912.
